home_tagline: A collection of shadcn components and blocks maintained by Hoogin. Collapsible sidebars, theme switching, and full application layouts — install them with one command.
docs_installationDescription: Add the component to your project with the shadcn CLI.
docs_registrySetup: Make sure the @hoogin registry is configured in your components.json:
docsComponents_description: Standalone, reusable components you can install with the shadcn CLI.
docsIntroduction_description: What is @hoogin and how the registry is organized.
docsIntroduction_whatIsBody: @hoogin is a shadcn component registry maintained by Hoogin. Every item is plain source code installed into your project by the shadcn CLI — no wrapper libraries, no runtime, just components you own and can edit.
docsIntroduction_componentsBody: — standalone reusable components such as the collapsible sidebar and theme-provider.
docsIntroduction_blocksBody: — cohesive layouts that compose several components, like sidebar-layout.
docsIntroduction_developmentBody: This very site is the development environment. Every component page renders the live component — edit the source in example/src/hoogin/ and the preview updates with hot module replacement.
docsInstallation_description: Add the @hoogin registry to your shadcn project and install items.
docsInstallation_step1Body: Add the @hoogin registry to your components.json:
docsInstallation_step2Body: The CLI resolves registry dependencies automatically — for example @hoogin/sidebar-layout pulls in the base shadcn components it needs.
docsInstallation_updatesBody: Re-run the add command to pull the latest version. Existing files are left untouched — pass --overwrite to replace them.
